message: No detected input validation: The code passes uploaded file contents and URLs directly to parsers/SharedDataFrame without any schema, type, or value-range validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: URLs submitted via the UI textarea are fetched without any checksum verification, authentication, or source integrity checks.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, and no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls are present anywhere in the pipeline stage.
No detected label distribution validation: The code covers data preparation and UI interactions but contains no label distribution validation or class balance checks before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no training loop present in this code, and no backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms are implemented anywhere in the provided snippets.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are referenced or used in any of the provided code files.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: The code is a data-cleaning/UI pipeline with no adversarial attack testing, no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any robustness stress-test framework.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code contains no evaluation metrics, no held-out test set isolation, no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and no multiple independent metrics — it is purely a data ingestion and cleaning UI.

No detected input sanitization: User-supplied data (file uploads, URLs, dropdown selections) is passed directly into SharedDataFrame and pandas processing without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: No model output is produced or checked in this inference path; there are no NaN guards, probability bounds, or threshold checks visible in the code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline does not involve an LLM or text-generation model, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
